proposed_urls.rationale: F.S. 11.045 - Lobbying Before the Legislature; Registration and Reporting; Exemptions; Penalties - the core legislative-branch lobbying-disclosure statute.
F.S. 11.0451 - Requirements for Reinstitution of Lobbyist Registration After Felony Conviction - lobbyist registration provision.
F.S. 11.0455 - Electronic Filing of Compensation Reports and Other Information - lobbying compensation-report filing mechanism.
F.S. 11.047 - Contingency Fees; Prohibitions; Penalties - lobbying contingency-fee prohibition tied to the 11.045 registration regime.
F.S. 11.061 - State, State University, and Community College Employee Lobbyists; Registration; Recording Attendance; Penalty; Exemptions - public-employee lobbyist registration.
F.S. 11.062 - Use of State Funds for Lobbying Prohibited; Penalty - related lobbying-conduct restriction in the same Ch. 11 cluster.

F.S. 112.3215 - Lobbying before the executive branch or the Constitution Revision Commission; registration and reporting; investigation by commission - the core executive-branch lobbying-disclosure statute.
F.S. 112.32151 - Requirements for reinstitution of lobbyist registration after felony conviction - executive-branch lobbyist registration provision.
F.S. 112.32155 - Electronic filing of compensation reports and other information - executive-branch lobbying compensation-report filing mechanism.
F.S. 112.3217 - Contingency fees; prohibitions; penalties - executive-branch lobbying contingency-fee prohibition tied to 112.3215 registration regime.
F.S. 112.3261 - Lobbying before water management districts; registration and reporting - additional executive-branch-style lobbying registration/reporting regime.
F.S. 112.3122 - Enforcement and penalties for constitutional prohibition against lobbying by a public officer - post-office lobbying restriction with definitions in 112.3121.
F.S. 112.3121 - Definitions - definitions specifically for the post-office lobbying prohibition enforced by 112.3122.
F.S. 112.3124 - Enforcement and penalties for constitutional prohibition against lobbying by a former justice or judge - post-office lobbying restriction for the judicial branch.
F.S. 112.3123 - Definitions - definitions specifically for the former-judge lobbying prohibition enforced by 112.3124.

F.S. 112.3148 - Reporting and prohibited receipt of gifts by individuals filing full or limited public disclosure of financial interests and by procurement employees - regulates gift reporting from lobbyists, cross-referenced from lobbying regime.
F.S. 112.312 - Definitions - general Part III (Code of Ethics) definitions including 'lobbyist'; invoked by 112.3215 and related sections.
F.S. 112.317 - Penalties - general Part III penalties provision invoked by Commission on Ethics enforcement of lobbying violations under 112.3215.

notes: FL 2025 vintage available on Justia; Method A passes 1/2/3 all cleared without Cloudflare interference on Dans-MacBook-Pro (first successful Method A FL 2025 dispatch since the 5/26 9/9 wall on Dans-MacBook-Air). FL has the canonical dual lobbying-disclosure regime: (a) legislative-branch lobbying in Title III Ch. 11 (sections 11.045-11.062; six sections matching the 2015 ground truth referenced in the b3 plans), and (b) executive-branch lobbying in Title X Ch. 112 Part III - Code of Ethics, administered by the Commission on Ethics. The Title X path is one level deeper than Title III (Ch. 112 is partitioned), requiring an additional pass-3 fetch on part-iii/ to reach section leaves. Tree depth = 6 path segments (florida/2025/title-x/chapter-112/part-iii/section-112-XXXX/). Executive-branch selections include the 112.3215 core, the 112.3217 contingency-fee prohibition, 112.32151/112.32155 registration-and-reporting follow-ons, 112.3261 (water management district lobbying), and the constitutional post-office lobbying-prohibition enforcement pair 112.3122/112.3124 with their localized definitions 112.3121/112.3123. Support set held minimal: 112.312 (general Part III definitions), 112.317 (penalties), 112.3148 (gift reporting from lobbyists). Excluded: financial-disclosure-only sections (112.3144-112.3145), whistleblower (112.3187-112.31901), standards-of-conduct (112.313, 112.3135-112.3136), retirement forfeiture (112.3173), and other Part III non-lobbying ethics provisions; Title III Ch. 10 (Senate/House internal procedure) and Title X Ch. 110/111/113-122 (employment, retirement, notaries, public records, administrative procedure) excluded as out-of-regime.
